falsification_conditions.condition: The asset's price closes above the 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a confirmed breakout from consolidation, invalidating the 'HOLD' signal and suggesting a new uptrend phase

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 80+ within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 80 would indicate extreme overbought conditions, contradicting the current 'HOLD' phase and suggesting imminent reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume surges to 150%+ of the 30-day average volume within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a volume spike would indicate strong conviction in a directional move, falsifying the 'UNKNOWN' verdict by confirming a clear trend

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
